name: SuperTuxKart
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: SuperTuxKart, the free kart racing game. Runs a LAN server, or an internet server listed in the game when you give it an STK online account.
startup: if [ -n "{{STK_USERNAME}}" ] && [ -n "{{STK_PASSWORD}}" ]; then set -- --wan-server="{{SERVER_NAME}}" --login="{{STK_USERNAME}}" --password="{{STK_PASSWORD}}"; else set -- --lan-server="{{SERVER_NAME}}"; fi; exec ./run_game.sh --server-config="{{CONFIG_NAME}}" --network-console "$@" --port={{SERVER_PORT}} --max-players={{MAX_PLAYERS}} --mode={{MODE}} --difficulty={{DIFFICULTY}} --motd="{{MOTD}}" ${SERVER_PASSWORD:+--server-password="$SERVER_PASSWORD"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SuperTuxKart. Downloads SuperTuxKart's official Linux release for the
# node's CPU from GitHub, checked against GitHub's checksum. The server's
# settings (the server config file) and add-ons are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=supertuxkart/stk-code
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=x86_64 ;;
aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
*) echo "SuperTuxKart has no Linux build for $(uname -m)."; exit 1 ;;
esac

tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "${VERSION:-latest}") ||
    { echo "SuperTuxKart has no release ${VERSION}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 1.5."; exit 1; }
asset="SuperTuxKart-$tag-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
sum=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2 }')
[ -n "$sum" ] || { echo "SuperTuxKart $tag has no Linux download for $arch."; exit 1; }

if [ "$(cat .raptor-stk 2>/dev/null)" = "$sum" ] && [ -x bin/supertuxkart ]; then
    echo "SuperTuxKart $tag is already installed."
    exit 0
fi

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
echo "Downloading SuperTuxKart $tag ($arch, about 700 MB)"
gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/stk.tar.gz"
echo "Unpacking"
tar -xzf "$build/stk.tar.gz" -C "$build"
rm -f "$build/stk.tar.gz"
new="$build/SuperTuxKart-$tag-linux-$arch"
[ -x "$new/bin/supertuxkart" ] || { echo "The download has no bin/supertuxkart in it."; exit 1; }
# The game's own folders are replaced whole; everything else stays.
for d in bin lib data; do
    rm -rf "$d"
    mv "$new/$d" "$d"
done
cp -f "$new/run_game.sh" run_game.sh
chmod +x run_game.sh bin/supertuxkart
echo "$sum" > .raptor-stk
echo "Installed SuperTuxKart $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The SuperTuxKart release to install, such as 1.5, or latest.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: 0 normal race, 1 time trial, 2 battle, 3 soccer, 4 follow the leader, 5 capture the flag.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players at once. More than 8 can slow the server down.

variables.name: Message of the day
variables.description: Shown to players in the lobby.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: A password players need to join. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: STK username
variables.description: Your SuperTuxKart online account. With its password set, the server is listed on the internet; empty runs a LAN server.

variables.name: STK password
variables.description: The password of that SuperTuxKart online account.

variables.name: Config file
variables.description: The server's settings file, created on the first start.
